text:
deploybot: FYI: planned quiet-window rollout for kernel matmul v3 + quant packing fixes tonight 03:15 UTC. Ratcheted slices: 0.5%, 3%, 15%, 100. Pin TTLs default to 25m/25m/45m/90m. Please ack and nominate watchers.

alex: ack. i'll watch p99 and request router errors.

maya: ack. @linh want you on GPU evictions and stream error tails. baseline panels: https://grafana.redwood/boards/runtime/quant-cutover

linh: on it. will run a live tail: `kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=runtime-canary --since=5m -f` and push to #eng-oncall on anomalies.

jorge: note: matmul v3 includes a different block-tiling path for short sequences (<128). ABI is compatible but codegen path differs; watch perf on microbench buckets. Also flipped a quant packing guard for legacy 8bit models.

sam: small litmus that caught a minor stream framing issue in staging; we added backpressure smoothing. monitor stream error ratio as separate metric.

alex: explicit rollback thresholds so we can automate?

maya: propose: sustained err_ratio>1.5% for 4m OR p99 latency >40% over baseline for 5m OR driver OOMs >0.4/min for 3m. Also add KV miss delta >12pp for 4m as manual trigger.

deploybot: configured. automated rollback triggers enabled. manual rollback command: `deploybot rollback --to runtime:matmulv2 --reason "regress"`.

linh: will escalate to ops if we see GPU evictions >2/min.

ops-bot: standby hotpool (us-west1, 3 gpus) available. attach via `opsctl attach --pool hot-standby --region us-west1`. attach time ~3m.

jorge: if we need immediate pin to old kernel: `deploybot pin --runtime matmulv2 --ttl 60 --why "fallback"`. tested earlier today.

alex: release note snippet: "Runtime: matmul v3 kernel + quant packing fixes. Canary in us-west1 then eu-west1. Expect throughput gains for medium-length prompts and reduced tokenization overhead for q8 models." Link: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2026-03-matmulv3

maya: ops ask: if we see flapping on 3% slice, reduce second slice TTL to 10m to allow faster unpin.

deploybot: rollout config: ```
strategy: ratchet
slices: [0.5,3,15,100]
regions: [[us-west1],[us-west1,eu-west1],[us-west1,eu-west1,us-east1],[*]]
pin_ttls_minutes: [25,25,45,90]
auto_rollback: ["err>1.5%:4m","p99>40%:5m","oom>0.4/min:3m"]
```

sam: bookmarking dashboards and will drop quick smoke script in #eng-oncall.

linh: smokewatch started.

deploybot: slice 0.5% started 03:15 UTC in us-west1.

linh: initial tail: no evictions, p99 +1%. KV hit unchanged.

deploybot: slice 0.5 complete. moving to 3% in 2m.

maya: quick curl smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"test"}'` -> streaming ok.

deploybot: slice 3% started (us-west1 + eu-west1).

sam: noticed a small p99 blip to +45% for 60s at minute 8 in eu-west1, but it recovered. no stream errors.

linh: confirmed transient, no OOMs. KV miss +3pp only.

deploybot: holding at 3% per plan. no auto-rollback.

alex: if that cosine spike repeats, we might preemptively pivot pin TTL to 10m for faster recovery.

maya: agreed. keep an eye.

deploybot: slice 3 complete. starting 15% slice. pin TTL now 45m.

jorge: 15% shows throughput +9% and p99 +6% overall. no OOMs.

sam: stream error rate stable. attaching smoke script results to the doc.

deploybot: initiating full rollout in 4m. ops-bot, please attach hotpool as precaution.

ops-bot: hotpool attached to us-west1.

deploybot: full rollout started.

maya: full rollout finished cleanly. drafting concise post-rollout note with p99, tokens/sec, error delta. will post to #eng-release and link docs.

alex: thanks team. add any microbench anomalies to the release doc.

linh: all quiet. closing watch.

deploybot: rollout complete with no rollbacks. summary will be posted in 20m.
